_comment: Step 19 (owner): Russia removed as a main topic; Technology & AI (tech_ai) added. Its boost cap is 1, like Economy & Markets: tech outlets publish many launches and deals, so +2 would lift routine product news into the topic path; +1 lets a real development (a frontier model, a chip export rule, a major breach) reach followers at 7 when the world scale gives it 6. In topic_specificity it sits above economy_markets (a chip export ban is a tech story first) and below the country and war topics. Step 17 (owner): the sample digest after the setup holds at most sample_max_stories, sample_per_topic per topic, best first. Step 16 (advisor, digest length): the main topics bar is 7 (topic_bar), custom topics keep 6 (custom_topic_bar). Step 15 (off means off): a story never reaches a reader who switched its main topic off (one of the six main topics); otherwise it needs one tag the reader has on. Step 8: a story is in a digest if final_score >= editorial_bar, or its main topic is followed and its topic_score >= topic_bar (topic_needs_boost: and above its final_score; the editor's boost is capped per topic by topic_boost_max); no fixed count, no topic cap; lowest-ranked stories are cut until the ONE message fits message_char_limit (below Telegram's fold). Digest settings shared by the Worker cron, worker/scripts/digest-cli.mjs and job/dupes.py (one place, same behaviour). Edit here, then redeploy the Worker. Scores: the editor's final_score (job/editor.py); a story the editor has not scored uses its first-pass importance minus unedited_offset.
